mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_tasks (id, shot_id, asset_id, status, prediction_id, output_path, error_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{shotId}, #{assetId}, #{status}, #{predictionId}, #{outputPath}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM video_tasks WHERE shot_id = #{shotId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM video_tasks WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'PROCESSING') ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_tasks WHERE shot_id = #{shotId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'SUBMITTING', 'PROCESSING')
